implementation.description: Compile the shared FP32 small-batch kernel in a dedicated native wave64 translation unit for selected bounded Qwen27B matrix shapes. Logical32-lane row ownership, coefficient decoding, per-output arithmetic and reductions are preserved. No execution switch or controller change.
implementation.selected_shapes: FFN up17408x5120 and packed gate/up34816x5120; down5120x17408. Q4 up/down widths5-8; Q5 up widths5/7/8 and down6-8; IQ4_XS up/down6-8; Q6 vocabulary248320x5120 widths7-8. Other shapes and widths remain wave32.
implementation.staging_and_indices: Q4 batch5 down uses one staged tile instead of two. IQ4 batch6 switches from64-bit to32-bit indices at bounded safe dimensions; this is separately qualified against the actual old wide-index kernel, not just the early narrow-index probe reference.
implementation.build: Native64 code uses -mwavefrontsize64; HIP helpers compile with the same feature. A template wave-size parameter disambiguates wave32/64 instantiations and scales the occupancy hint. The existing dflash_gemm_bench links this production translation unit; no new maintained tool or test executable.

initial_extended.method: Actual Q4 target mapped FFN and Q6 head tensors, widths5–8, production geometries. Original and unchanged wave32 clone versus separate -mwavefrontsize64 kernel translation unit with the minimum hardware-wave hint halved. All logical32-lane dot/reduction operations, FP32 order, weights and LDS layout unchanged. Two full-mantissa seeds19/971, all outputs finite/bit-exact before6rotated-order rounds x8rotations through up to8tensors. Confirm wave size from ISA metadata.

cases.name: iq4-b6-17408-5120
cases.reference_caveat: Probe variant named production uses32-bit indices; the actual old production used64-bit indices. Separate actual-index control supersedes this speed estimate.

cases.name: iq4-b6-5120-17408
cases.reference_caveat: Probe variant named production uses32-bit indices; the actual old production used64-bit indices. Separate actual-index control supersedes this speed estimate.

batch5_tuning.method: Q4 target actual mapped Q4/Q5/IQ4 FFNs, batch5. Production numerical template, wave32 reference/clone, current wave64 geometry and four alternative wave64 geometries. Preserve all FP32 arithmetic and weights. Two full-mantissa seeds53/1297, every output finite/bit-exact before seven rotated-order rounds x6rotations through up to8tensors. Current production uses wave64 for Q4/Q5 up and wave32 otherwise.

batch6_iq4_actual_index_control.method: Actual mapped IQ4_XS FFNs, batch6. Old production wave32 with 64-bit indices compared to wave32/32-bit, wave64/32-bit and wave64/64-bit. Unchanged numerical production template W16/R3/T2/Min12, adjusted native occupancy hint. Two full-mantissa seeds53/1297, all finite and bit-exact before seven balanced rounds x6 rotations through up to8 matrices. All variants compared to old wave32/64-bit route.

short_width_followup.method: Actual mapped Q4/Q5/IQ4 FFNs and Q6 vocabulary head, widths3/4. Match production wave32 geometry and index width exactly (IQ4 B4 down uses64-bit indices; Q5 B4 down uses tokenstep2). Wave32 unchanged clone control and wave64 production numerical template with equal index width. Two full-mantissa seeds31/997, every output finite/bit-exact before six balanced rounds x8 rotations through up to8tensors.
short_width_followup.decision: Q4 batch4 up, Q5 batch4 down and IQ4 batch4 down are candidates for the next integration; not part of the currently qualified production change. Other short-width cases are slower or marginal. IQ4 batch4 down retains its production64-bit indices.

paired_release_speed.method: Q4 target/Q4 draft, C1, greedy. Adaptive raw JSON/prose TG300: two timed samples per binary in ABBA order, 128-token raw prose warmup per binary excluded. Fixed-7 repetition chat TG128: two paired samples per binary in ABBA order. Includes prefill, excludes model loading. All IDs and acceptance statistics checked against qualified AR references. Candidate uses wave64 for selected Q4/Q5/IQ4 FFNs at widths5–8 and Q6 vocabulary heads at widths7–8. Logical32-lane arithmetic is unchanged. Q4 batch5 FFNdown uses one staged tile; IQ4 batch6 uses bounded32-bit indices. Other shapes retain wave32. Draft, state and controller are unchanged.

ar_control.method: Q4 target, scalar AR, C1, pp2048/tg128, depth0, one benchmark repetition per invocation after built-in warmup. Four invocations in ABBA order; all128IDs must equal the fresh baseline and every repetition. Separate pp/tg rates from release gufo bench; no other depth or Q8 speed claim.

profile_attribution.method: Existing qualified prose baseline trace is reused; candidate proseTG300 trace is fresh. Strip the additional hardware-wave template parameter; normalize only the three bounded IQ4 batch6 grid groups that also change from64-bit to32-bit indexing, and the Q4 batch5 down group that changes from two staged tiles to one. Compare complete kernel/grid/block unions. Some unions combine selected FFNs with unchanged shapes; retain both candidate wave modes in those comparisons. All dispatch counts match. Diagnostic GPU times are not the fresh paired release speed estimate.

limits: Finite exact-output regression coverage, not independent original-checkpoint or broad capability qualification.
The initial extended IQ4 batch6 probe used32-bit indices for its wave32 reference; use the explicit actual-index follow-up for the production comparison.
Fresh C1 Q4/Q4 controls at short context only. No refreshed full depth sweep, Q8 speed or C>1 throughput claim.
Baseline diagnostic profile is explicitly reused; fresh paired release measurements supply speed claims.
The original FP4 headline65.6JSON/26.1prose decode-only goal remains unmatched; different artifacts and timing conventions prevent treating it as a matched comparison.
production_isa_build: Optimized focused gufo_core production translation unit at build/gpu-test/CMakeFiles/gufo_core.dir/src/models/qwen/hip/kernels/small_batch_wave64.hip.o. Both Nix release and focused CMake builds compile this source with -mwavefrontsize64; the release profile independently confirms selected hardware64 template instantiations and zero private scratch.
